text:
No treaty ended World War II, and Versailles (1919) ended World War I, so my earlier statement was wrong.

WWII ended through surrenders: Germany's in May 1945 and Japan's on September 2, 1945. Formal peace settlements came later:

- Paris Peace Treaties (1947) with Italy, Romania, Hungary, Bulgaria, and Finland
- Treaty of San Francisco (1951, in force 1952) with Japan
- Austrian State Treaty (1955)
- Treaty on the Final Settlement with Respect to Germany, or "Two Plus Four" (1990), which is the closest thing to a final WWII settlement
